english_title: 23. When he Asked God for Well-Being

phrases.english: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.clothe me in Your well-being, wrap me in Your well-being,
3.fortify me through Your well-being, honour me with Your well-being,
4.free me from need through Your well-being, donate to me Your well-being,
5.bestow upon me Your well-being, spread out for me Your well-being,

phrases.arabic: وَأَصْلِحْ لِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَلا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَافِيَتِكَ
phrases.english: 6.set Your well-being right for me, and separate me not from Your well-being
7.in this world and the next!
8.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَعَافِنِي عَافِيَةً كَافِيَةً شَافِيَةً عَالِيَةً نَامِيةً،
phrases.english: 9.and make me well with a well-being sufficient, healing, sublime, growing,
10.a well-being that will give birth to well-being in my body,
11.a well-being in this world and the next!

phrases.arabic: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالأمْنِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِي دِيْنِي وَبَـدَنِي،
phrases.english: 12.Oblige me through health, security, and safety in my religion and body,

phrases.arabic: وَالْبَصِيرَةِ فِي قَلْبِي وَالنَّفَاذِ فِي أمُورِيْ وَالْخَشْيَةِ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 13.insight in my heart, penetration in my affairs, dread of You,

phrases.arabic: وَالْخَوْفِ مِنْكَ وَالْقُوَّةِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
phrases.english: 14.fear of You, strength for the obedience which You hast commanded for me,

phrases.arabic: وَالاجْتِنَابِ لِمَـا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِـكَ.
phrases.english: 15.and avoidance of the disobedience which You hast prohibited for me!
16.O God, oblige me through the hajj, the umra,
17.and visiting the graves of Your Messenger (Your blessings,
18.mercy, and benedictions upon him and upon his Household)

phrases.arabic: وَآلِ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي،
phrases.english: 19.and the Household of Your Messenger (upon them be peace) for as long as You causest me to live,

phrases.arabic: فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَفِي كُلِّ عَام،
phrases.english: 20.in this year of mine and in every year,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ مَقْبُولاً مَشْكُوراً مَذْكُوراً لَدَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 21.and make that accepted, thanked, and mentioned before You
22.and stored away with You!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْطِقْ بِحَمْدِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ الثَّناءِ  عَلَيْكَ لِسَانِي،
phrases.english: 23.Make my tongue utter Your praise, Your thanksgiving, Your remembrance, and Your excellent laudation,
24.and expand my heart toward the right goals of Your religion!
25.Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ وَالْعَامَّةِ وَاللاَّمَّةِ
phrases.english: 26.the evil of venomous vermin, threatening pests, swarming crowds, and evil eyes,
27.the evil of "every rebel satan" (22:3),
28.the evil of every refractory sovereign,
29.the evil of everyone living in ease and served,
30.the evil of everyone weak or strong,
31.the evil of everyone born high or low,
32.the evil of everyone small or great,
33.the evil of everyone near or far,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ وَلأهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبَـاً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ،
phrases.english: 34.the evil of every one, jinn or man, who declares war on Your Messenger and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرّ كُلِّ دَابَّة أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
phrases.english: 35.and the evil of "every crawling creature that You hast taken by the forelock!
36.Surely You art on a straight path"(ref.11:56).
37.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوء فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ،
phrases.english: 38.and if someone desires ill for me turn him away from me, drive away from me his deception,

phrases.arabic: وَادْرَأ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَرُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِي نَحْرِهِ،
phrases.english: 39.avert from me his evil, send his trickery back to his own throat,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَدّاً حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّي بَصَرَهُ،
phrases.english: 40.and place before him a barricade, so that You mayest blind his eyes toward me,

phrases.arabic: وَتُصِمَّ عَنْ ذِكْري سَمْعَهُ، وَتُقْفِلَ دُونَ إخْطَارِي قَلْبَهُ،
phrases.english: 41.deafen his ears toward my mention, lock his heart toward recalling me,
42.silence his tongue against me, restrain his head,
43.abase his exaltation, break his arrogance,
44.abase his neck, disjoint his pride,
45.and make me secure from all his injury,
46.his evil, his slander, his backbiting, his faultfinding, his envy,
47.his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot soldiers, and his cavalry!
48.Surely You art Mighty, Powerful!
